findings.title: Per-tick cost trap: R38 item 5's smell check makes the world food-source grid rebuild on nearly every tick
findings.where: src/sim/ants/behaviours/outdoor/notice.ts noteSmelledFood -> src/sim/ecology/sources/discovery.ts sourcesSmelledFrom -> lookup.ts gridOf/build
findings.detail: Each outside worker calls sourcesSmelledFrom every 20 ticks. lookup.ts rebuilds its whole-world grid on the first query of each tick, and with staggered workers some worker queries on almost every tick. Median behaviours cost went from 0.19 ms/tick (sweep 9) and 0.25 (round-10 arm) to 0.70 (round-11 arm) and 0.63 (sweep 11). Median total went from 3.67 to 4.13 ms/tick. In a CPU profile of kd #1 (life.ts --perf 3000), noticeOutside is 69 % of runBehaviour, and 4.7 of its 4.9 s are in the grid's build/gridOf. New test src/sim/ants/behaviours/outdoor/noticeCost.verify.test.ts is RED and kept: 2000 checks take 1186 ms on new ticks against 16 ms on one tick (2500 sources).

findings.title: Protein intake fell against sweep 9 (median 0.478 -> 0.353), the only R19 check that fails
findings.detail: P delivered fell from 176 to 137 (prey 141 -> 105, carrion 11.4 -> 5.8). Worker time moved from forage (655 -> 516 worker-gd) to tend (402 -> 520) and scout (150 -> 242). 252 of 299 scout trips found nothing. The round arm's carrion gain did not repeat in fresh runs: 24.8 P in the arm, 12.3 of it from pp #1's large carcass, against 5.8 P in the sweep. P intake is lower than in sweep 9 in 11 of 15 runs.

findings.title: Brood hygiene is the largest brood loss and grew with round 11
findings.detail: Hygiene brood deaths: sweep 41 -> 56, paired arms 31 -> 60. In both the round's arm and this sweep they rose in cpv #2 (2 -> 14), kd #3 (0 -> 10), sg #1 (0 -> 7) and sg #3 (0 -> 5-9). In year two they kill 14 of we #2's 20 eggs and 6 of cpv #1's 19. The round's trace (one hauler held outside by the flood hold) explains cpv #2 only. Nothing yet shows which R38 item raised hygiene deaths in four colonies at once.

findings.title: R38 item 1 serves the whole scout demand ahead of forage, not only the floor
findings.where: src/sim/colony/allocation/targets.ts planTargets (Math.round(demand) for scout when scoutsFirst)
findings.detail: The ruling fills the missing-nutrient floor (min(0.25 n, max(1 or 2, 0.2 n))) before forage. Where the small-colony rule asks for 2 scouts, a 6-worker colony sends 2 scouts before forage, more than the floor (1) and the 0.25 x 6 cap. src/sim/colony/scoutsFirst.verify.test.ts case 1 is RED and kept (scouts 2, forage 2 of 6). The integrator already put this in direction 26 item 3.

findings.title: The round's tests for R38 items 2, 3 and 5 do not cover the runner wiring
findings.detail: All three call noticeOutside directly, so none fails if behaviourRunner.ts stops calling it. New test src/sim/ants/behaviours/outdoor/noticeSaveLoad.verify.test.ts is GREEN. It shows a non-scout taking a smelled-food report through the runner on real ticks, and that a save -> load with pending notice state gives equal hashes after 1500 ticks.

findings.title: R38 item 4's second trace (pp #3 insect-large) was not made
findings.detail: Direction 24 item 4 asked for traces of both the large carcass (kd #1) and the large insect (pp #3). Only kd #1 was traced. The density fix covers both kinds, but the trip-continuation question for pp #3 is unanswered.
